purpose: Executable/inspectable design vectors for R5.3 author-final qualification, preserving FR-01–FR-14 and R5N-01–R5N-33 coverage while adding the final zero-based authority/identity hardening. Expected outcomes are specification checks, not runtime BDB test results.

vectors.title: Simple independent ObjectDigest vector
vectors.why: ASCII-only fixture avoids Unicode serializer ambiguity and pins domain-separation bytes.

vectors.title: F7 retains both required reasons
vectors.why: R5 must not regress the R4 F7 fix.

vectors.title: Same-commit cycle reject
vectors.why: No topological ordering exists.

vectors.title: Dependency order beats lexical/type order
vectors.why: B depends on A even if typed lexical ordering would choose assignment_manifest first.

vectors.title: Duplicate object ref rejected
vectors.why: Commit closure is a sequence of unique object refs; duplicate membership is not a second valid representation.

vectors.title: Independent siblings deterministic tie-break
vectors.why: Zero-indegree siblings use kind/logical_id/digest tie-break.

vectors.title: Ambiguous semantic mapping cannot auto-qualify evidence
vectors.why: Mapping does not create current evidence truth.

vectors.title: Semantic scope is not aggregate partial
vectors.why: SCOPED and MAPPED are independent axes.

vectors.title: Scoped semantic equivalence with partial aggregate mapping
vectors.why: No implicit conversion between axes.

vectors.title: Fr03 Blocked Admission No Genesis
vectors.why: Fresh R5.1 regression vector; exact expected result is part of the candidate foundation contract.

vectors.title: Fr03 Bootstrap Ref Order Reject
vectors.why: Fresh R5.1 regression vector; exact expected result is part of the candidate foundation contract.

vectors.title: Fr03 Bootstrap Single Commit Accept
vectors.why: Fresh R5.1 regression vector; exact expected result is part of the candidate foundation contract.

vectors.title: Empty history rejected after initialization
vectors.why: No synthetic restart of accepted history.

vectors.title: First accepted commit uses tagged empty history
vectors.why: Tagged initialization variant is legal only before H1.

vectors.title: Fr03 Init Future Campaign Ref Reject
vectors.why: Fresh R5.1 regression vector; exact expected result is part of the candidate foundation contract.

vectors.title: Fr03 Source Reconciliation Dangling Reject
vectors.why: Fresh R5.1 regression vector; exact expected result is part of the candidate foundation contract.

vectors.title: Fault execution DAG
vectors.why: Result never receives a backlink from a record that itself points to result.

vectors.title: No-fault control DAG
vectors.why: Control run needs no fabricated fault record.

vectors.title: Execution result/fault backlink cycle rejected
vectors.why: Literal result backlink cycle is illegal.

vectors.title: First release qualification after release-only drift
vectors.why: No fabricated predecessor is needed.

vectors.title: Later reassessment needs exact predecessor
vectors.why: Later release reassessment is explicitly chained.

vectors.title: Challenger cannot precede candidate
vectors.why: Challenge must bind exact immutable candidate revision.

vectors.title: Canonical E5 finalization order
vectors.why: Candidate exists before challengers; E5 completes after required challenge results.

vectors.title: Separate Root Cause membership authority rejected
vectors.why: Only RootCauseRevision.membership_edges is authority.

vectors.title: Attempt result does not close lane
vectors.why: Lane and Attempt are distinct aggregates.

vectors.title: Foundation cannot skip E0 readiness
vectors.why: Foundation path must be a subset of the same transition profile.

vectors.title: Competing successor branches fail closed
vectors.why: There cannot be two equal current assurance authorities.

vectors.title: Accepted typed successor branch selection resolves current selector
vectors.why: Selected successor must belong to exact candidate set; rejected branch remains immutable history.

vectors.title: Post-conclusion material trigger creates successor campaign
vectors.why: Historical conclusion stays immutable while current assurance advances through successor chain.

vectors.title: Epistemic outcome separated from method
vectors.why: Method does not encode truth outcome.

vectors.title: Authorization proposal accepted with transition
vectors.why: Proposal does not move head before consumption.

vectors.title: Intervening head invalidates stale proposal
vectors.why: Exact expected parent/CAS remains authoritative.

vectors.title: Consumed proposal cannot authorize second effect
vectors.why: No second mutable authorization state.

vectors.title: Cross-domain status injection rejected
vectors.why: STALE_FOR_CURRENT_SOURCE belongs to FindingLifecycle, not evidence applicability.

vectors.title: PROVISIONAL does not satisfy terminal input accounting
vectors.why: PROVISIONAL is intermediate only.

vectors.title: Post-reveal discovery cannot satisfy blind precursor
vectors.why: Blind precursor must be accepted before checkpoint/reveal.

vectors.title: Milestone namespaces are disjoint
vectors.why: Same numeral in distinct explicit namespaces is unambiguous.

vectors.title: Critical registry wiring must be explicit
vectors.why: Critical foundation kinds cannot rely on an ambiguous empty ref list.

vectors.title: Unknown registry role rejected
vectors.why: Machine registry role domain is frozen and typed.

vectors.title: Bootstrap profile pin parity
vectors.why: Profile and installation_bootstrap_profile contract must require exactly the same pins.

vectors.title: Dangling registry target rejected
vectors.why: Every allowed ref target must resolve to a registered kind or typed reference target class.

vectors.title: Freeze via external governance decision
vectors.why: Independent PASS must not force editing reviewed corpus and invalidating its own verdict.

vectors.title: Schema-bound kind blocked until exact bytes exist
vectors.why: Foundation may freeze semantic key while runtime acceptance remains fail-closed until executable schema binding.

vectors.title: Golden vector schema is uniform
vectors.why: Runner dispatch and review must not silently skip vectors with a different shape.

vectors.title: STOP profile machine binding parity
vectors.why: Registry STOP profile and Data Contracts StopInput must name the same required bindings.

vectors.title: Backward-only ref cannot target same commit
vectors.why: Previous/predecessor/parent/retry/prior-result references must bind an already accepted object and cannot be reinterpreted as same-commit content.

vectors.title: Inline foundation reference type graph is acyclic
vectors.why: Machine ref classes must not reintroduce a type-level cycle into bootstrap/evidence/finalization semantics.

vectors.title: History input cannot be ordinary same-commit content
vectors.why: History/acceptance context must represent prior accepted input or the tagged initialization sentinel, never a current-commit cut.

input.rule: every material_refs[].ref_class must exist in reference_class_semantics

vectors.title: Every reference class has pinned semantics
vectors.why: Undefined ref-class tokens would reintroduce implementation-dependent legality.

vectors.title: Canonical narrative name and registry kind are identity-equivalent
vectors.why: ObjectDigest domain separation includes kind; a shortened/renamed alias would create a distinct identity.

vectors.title: Historical review quotations do not poison current-corpus negative scans
vectors.why: Review provenance can quote rejected semantics without making them current normative text.

vectors.title: StopEvaluation must bind one exact StopInput
vectors.why: Same HistoryCut can admit distinct fully-bound StopInput revisions; copied input fields are not an unambiguous input identity.

vectors.title: Release assessment basis is history input, never same-commit content
vectors.why: Release assessment may use an earlier accepted basis cut but cannot create the history it claims to assess.

vectors.title: ObjectDigest domain kind equals exact Registry wire kind
vectors.why: Aliases such as command/commit would produce a second identity for the same body.

vectors.title: Receipt commit ref points to CommitBody, not AcceptedHead
vectors.why: Commit identity and head pointer are distinct acceptance artifacts.

vectors.title: EXPLICIT_COMPLETE means exact body↔Registry ref parity
vectors.why: A supposedly complete machine wiring contract cannot silently omit a material ref from the normative body.

input.governing_policy_ref: new policy object earlier in accepting H11 commit

vectors.title: Same-commit policy/spec cannot validate the command that installs it
vectors.why: Governing semantic context comes from prior accepted history or installation pins at EMPTY_HISTORY.

vectors.title: Remediation register finding table remains structurally contiguous
vectors.why: Findings must not disappear from machine/human table parsing due to Markdown structure.

vectors.title: Legacy short evidence kind is not an identity alias
vectors.why: Exact wire identity is normalized to evidence_qualification_assessment / evidence_applicability_assessment; old short kinds cannot remain alternate ObjectDigest domains.

vectors.title: CoverageObligationKey digest kind is registered
vectors.why: An identity-bearing ObjectDigest domain cannot exist outside the pinned identity registry.

vectors.title: STOP evaluator and stage-plan profiles are history-context bindings
vectors.why: STOP cannot redefine its evaluator or required stage plan inside the same commit as the evaluation input.

vectors.title: Normal CampaignGenesis exists only at empty-history initialization
vectors.why: Post-conclusion continuation must use SuccessorCampaignGenesis and cannot mint a second normal genesis on existing history.

vectors.title: Event-enriched exposure projection is not a competing canonical body
vectors.why: Event position and dereferenced delivery profile enrich a derived view without changing PotentialExposureRecord identity.

vectors.title: Same-commit actor/authority object cannot authorize its accepting command
vectors.why: Actor identity is not itself authorization; authority comes from prior accepted or installation-pinned trust context.

vectors.title: STOP binds direct mandatory obligations
vectors.why: Derived coverage summary cannot become a second coverage authority.

vectors.title: New commit cannot reuse prior command envelope
vectors.why: CommitBody.command_ref must identify the command accepted by that exact commit.

vectors.title: Normal command requires prior campaign
vectors.why: Same-commit CampaignGenesis is initialization-only and cannot satisfy ordinary command campaign binding.

vectors.title: HistoryCut separates governing specs from schema set
vectors.why: Spec revision context and schema-set identity are different domains.

vectors.title: Receipt command must equal accepted commit command
vectors.why: Acceptance sidecar cannot point at a different command than the accepted CommitBody.

vectors.title: Candidate assurance binds canonical coverage refs
vectors.why: A derived summary may be presented but cannot establish candidate coverage assurance.

vectors.title: STOP invalidation state derives from exact facts
vectors.why: A scalar invalidation state alone is not reproducible evidence authority.

vectors.title: Bootstrap closure includes CommandEnvelope
vectors.why: CommitBody.command_ref must point to the command accepted by the same deterministic closure; the global bootstrap model cannot omit it.

vectors.title: Ref arrays have pinned default ordering
vectors.why: EXPLICIT_COMPLETE contracts remain deterministic even when a set-like ref array does not need a local ordering override.

vectors.title: EMPTY HistoryCut is not an accepted fact
vectors.why: Bootstrap input cannot require a pre-existing acceptance event before the first history exists.

vectors.title: Stale STOP snapshot rejected
vectors.why: Derived snapshot is a reproducibility aid and must equality-bind the exact direct StopInput context.

vectors.title: Finalization chain cannot mix STOP evaluations
vectors.why: Conclusion, Final Assurance Case and Release Qualification must refer to one exact finalization chain.

vectors.title: STOP output obligations come from exact input set
vectors.why: Evaluator cannot invent, omit-by-rebinding, or switch obligation identity outside referenced StopInput.

vectors.title: Current artifact references point to R5.3
vectors.why: Historical R5.2 references may remain as provenance, but current validator/vector/baseline references must identify exact R5.3 artifacts.

vectors.title: Author qualification uses external post-readback record
vectors.why: Candidate bytes cannot truthfully attest a future manifest/readback result without recreating the same self-reference problem as freeze status.

vectors.title: Input and scope provisional states are not aliases
vectors.why: FR-13 requires separate InputDisposition and ScopeState domains; a shared lexical token would invite cross-domain mapping.

vectors.title: Challenger assignment requires prior accepted candidate
vectors.why: Assignment must exist as an accepted instruction before challenger execution; same-commit candidate cannot establish that temporal boundary.

vectors.title: Challenger result requires prior accepted assignment
vectors.why: A result cannot prove execution of an assignment that was not accepted before the result input cut.

vectors.title: Campaign conclusion requires prior accepted STOP
vectors.why: ConcludeCampaign is a separate state transition based on an already accepted StopEvaluation.

vectors.title: Release qualification requires prior accepted finalization chain
vectors.why: qualification_command_input_history_cut must already contain FinalAssuranceCase and all material refs.

input.registry_rule: central knowledge/coverage/evidence authority wiring is frozen at foundation, not deferred to implementation schema binding

vectors.title: Central foundation authority contracts are explicit-complete
vectors.why: Author-final baseline without another independent review must not defer material typed-reference semantics for the core knowledge/coverage/evidence chain.

vectors.title: Candidate cannot self-establish author qualification
vectors.why: Manifest/readback happen after candidate bytes are fixed; effective YES must be derived from an external post-readback record.

vectors.title: External author baseline qualification after exact readback
vectors.why: Allows implementation under explicitly author-only assurance without fabricating independent freeze.

vectors.title: Coverage obligation policy context requires exact input history
vectors.why: History-context-bound policy/profile predicates need a concrete prior input cut; otherwise the obligation can be semantically self-upgraded.

vectors.title: Coverage waiver has one canonical authority
vectors.why: A second canonical waiver kind would let two object families independently change current waiver state.

vectors.title: Campaign lifecycle has one authority path
vectors.why: Campaign identity is established by genesis; current lifecycle state is derived from accepted transitions, not a second mutable/canonical campaign object.

vectors.title: Run creation contracts freeze typed references
vectors.why: StageRun/LaneRun/Attempt are foundation authority and their reference semantics must not be invented later by implementation schemas.

vectors.title: Trusted predecessor selection has distinct wire identity
vectors.why: Generic approval cannot replace the exact predecessor selection decision in the first-history content DAG.

vectors.title: First-history admission chain freezes typed refs
vectors.why: The bootstrap DAG must not defer material ref semantics to implementation after author qualification.

vectors.title: Governance actor uses authority reference class
vectors.why: An actor/authority identity is not a configuration profile and must not inherit profile substitution semantics.

vectors.title: Coverage and finding decisions freeze typed refs
vectors.why: Current applicability, waiver and M/R/I authority cannot depend on unspecified later schema wiring.

vectors.title: Campaign genesis uses exact bootstrap admission enum
vectors.why: Stale shorthand result names must not become accepted aliases for identity/validation semantics.

vectors.title: Canonical predecessor requires exact trusted selection
vectors.why: Canonical admission cannot rely on implicit coordinator choice; selection must be an exact earlier decision for the same legacy/source/lineage context.

vectors.title: Predecessor pin belongs to bootstrap trust boundary
vectors.why: Canonical predecessor selection cannot acquire trust from an arbitrary same-workspace pin.

vectors.title: Campaign genesis cannot self-authorize its owner or semantic context
vectors.why: The first accepted campaign must derive owner/policy/spec/schema authority from the pre-existing installation trust root.

vectors.title: Blind discovery provenance freezes typed refs
vectors.why: Blind-origin assurance must not depend on later implementation-defined wiring of checkpoint/discovery/event/isolation refs.

vectors.title: Invariant/materiality backlink cycle rejected
vectors.why: Materiality points to an already existing subject; the subject never points forward to the assessment.

vectors.title: SurfaceRecord has registered wire identity
vectors.why: Canonical surface records cannot exist outside the artifact kind registry.

vectors.title: Coverage materiality binds exact assessment
vectors.why: Avoids a duplicated materiality scalar and a separate assessment authority.

vectors.title: Core inventory/invariant/materiality contracts are explicit
vectors.why: Author-final foundation should not defer central denominator semantics to later schema design.

vectors.title: Evidence assessment canonical wire kind parity
vectors.why: Digest-domain kind must match canonical contract identity exactly.

vectors.title: Exact duplicate RootCause membership edge is rejected
vectors.why: duplicate structured edges cannot create alternate semantic encodings

vectors.title: RootCause structured membership has deterministic tuple ordering
vectors.why: membership edge is structured, so ref-only default ordering is insufficient for ObjectDigest determinism

vectors.title: Terminal inventory requires one current disposition per assigned input
vectors.why: an assigned input must not disappear from accounting or have ambiguous duplicate current dispositions

vectors.title: Inventory accounting refs cannot cross domains
vectors.why: assigned inputs, disposition records and scope-state records are different typed domains

vectors.title: COMPLETED_LIMITED cannot receive READY ReleaseQualification
vectors.why: READY requires full completed PASS + adequate assurance chain

vectors.title: Non-PASS STOP cannot advertise READY release axis
vectors.why: separate C12 axes still require fail-closed cross-axis consistency against false-ready

vectors.title: Executable schema may bind during implementation but before first acceptance
vectors.why: foundation freezes semantics without pretending every future executable schema byte already exists

vectors.title: Command actor cannot self-authorize in the same commit
vectors.why: authorization must pre-exist the command it authorizes

vectors.title: Source authority cannot be invented by its own source object
vectors.why: repository/snapshot authority must be independently pinned/authorized
